title: AI Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

* We are seeking a highly skilled Python Generative AI Developer with 4 to 7 years of software development experience to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and modern cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong Python expertise, hands\-on experience with Generative AI frameworks, and a solid understanding of scalable backend architectures.
* Experience with DevOps practices and cloud deployment is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain Generative AI applications and services using Python.
* Build and optimize LLM\-powered solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
* Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and embedding models.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and third\-party services.
* Fine\-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI models for performance, accuracy, and cost efficiency.
* Create and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices for AI workloads. Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver AI\-driven solutions.
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and security best practices.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, models, and industry trends.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

**Technical Skills**

\- 4 to 7 years of professional software development experience.\- Strong proficiency in Python and related frameworks.

\- Hands\-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).\- Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or similar models.

\- Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent frameworks.

\- Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, RAG architectures, Vector Databases, Embeddings and Semantic Search, AI Agents and Tool Calling.\- Experience developing APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.\- Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.

\- Experience with Git and modern software development practices.

**Cloud \& Deployment**

\- Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.\- Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docke

**Good to Have (DevOps \& Infrastructure)**

\- Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

\- Experience with Kubernetes.

\- Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.

\- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

\- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Datadog.

\- Understanding of cloud\-native deployments and scalability concepts.

\- Experience deploying AI/ML workloads in production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with model evaluation frameworks and LLM observability tools.
* Familiarity with MLOps concepts and workflows.
* Exposure to AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Description \- AI Engineer

About the job

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer with strong expertise in building, fine\-tuning, and deploying advanced AI/ML solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with LLMs, NLP, and RAG systems, and a proven track record of implementing scalable AI applications on cloud platforms.

Key Skills:

\* Design, develop, and optimize AI/ML models with a primary focus on NLP and LLM applications.

\* Fine\-tune large language models (LLMs) and design effective prompt engineering strategies.

\* Build and deploy Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus).

\* Leverage frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and LlamaIndex for advanced AI solutions.

\* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI models into business applications.

\* Deploy and manage AI workloads efficiently on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

\* Utilize Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployment of AI services.

\* Explore and implement AI models for multilingual NLP, with an emphasis on Indic languages.

* (Preferred) Apply AI techniques in healthcare and medical domains for domain\-specific solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications :

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related fields.

\* 2–5 years of proven experience in AI/ML development, specifically in NLP and LLMs.

Expertise in:

\* Transformers (Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex)

\* LLM fine\-tuning \& prompt engineering

\* RAG architectures \& vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus)

\* Proficiency in Python, with experience in PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.

\* Strong background in cloud\-based AI deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP).

\* Experience in containerization \& orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

\* Familiarity with multi\-language NLP, with exposure to Indic languages preferred.

\* Knowledge of medical AI models will be considered an added advantage.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI Developer with OpenAI & Python Expertise
description:

We’re hiring **AI Developers** with experience in:

* **Python frameworks**: FastAPI, Flask, Django
* **Machine Learning \& Deep Learning**: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn

* Understanding of function calling, tool use, prompt design, and system messages
* **Prompt Engineering \& Model Programming**:
* Crafting efficient and task\-specific prompts
* Fine\-tuning and optimizing LLMs or integrating with vector databases like Pinecone or FAISS

Nice to Have:

* Experience in LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks
* Familiarity with deploying models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

* A cross\-functional, agile team of AI experts, engineers, and product managers
* Real\-world projects with international clients
* A culture of learning, ownership, and innovation

Full\-time / Contract\-based roles available

How to Apply:

Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio links, and a brief note on your recent AI work to hr@softrefine.com.

Let’s build the future of AI together.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

title: Programming & Electronic Engineer Mentor
description:
**About the Role**

TIS runs makerspace and innovation programmes inside schools. As a Programming \+ Electronics Mentor, you will teach and guide students from Grades 1\-8 through hands\-on learning in coding, electronics, and physical computing. You will run makerspace activities. You will help students move from curiosity to building, tinkering, and problem\-solving with real projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Teaching and mentoring**

● Deliver class\-appropriate programming and electronics sessions across Grades 1\-8 as per curriculum, from unplugged coding and block\-based tools in the early grades to text\-based coding and microcontroller projects in the upper grades.

● Guide students through circuits, sensors, motors, LEDs, and microcontroller platforms such as Arduino, micro:bit, and ESP32\.

● Facilitate project\-based, inquiry\-driven learning that fits an IB (PYP/MYP) approach.

● Encourage design thinking, debugging, iteration, and reflection in every project.

**Curriculum and content**

● Help implement makerspace curriculum, including lesson plans, project guides, and assessment rubrics.

● Prepare learning materials, demo builds, and student worksheets.

● Contribute ideas for showcase events, exhibitions, and student\-led conferences.

**Makerspace operations**

● Maintain tools, components, and kits, and keep inventory records.

● Enforce safety practices for soldering, power tools, batteries, and electronics.

● Keep the lab organised, labelled, and ready for sessions.

**Collaboration and reporting**

● Work closely with school teachers, coordinators, and the TIS team to align sessions with the school calendar.

● Track student progress and share updates and feedback with the Program Manager.

● Document projects with photos, videos, and short write\-ups.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience).

● Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C/C\+\+, or Scratch, and block\-based platforms.

● Hands\-on experience with Arduino or similar microcontrollers, basic circuit design, and sensors/actuators.

● Ability to explain technical concepts simply to children of different ages.

● Strong classroom management, patience, and communication skills.

● Comfort with troubleshooting hardware and software issues in real time.

**Good to Have**

● Experience teaching or mentoring school students, or running workshops or clubs.

● Familiarity with robotics platforms or competitions.

● Exposure to IB, project\-based, or inquiry\-led learning.

● Basic knowledge of 3D printing, CAD, or laser cutting.

● Interest in AI/ML concepts for young learners.

**What We're Looking For**

● A curious, hands\-on maker who enjoys learning alongside students

● A patient, energetic communicator who can hold attention across age groups

● A team player who is organised, dependable, and safety\-conscious

● Someone who welcomes feedback and keeps improving their teaching

**What You'll Gain**

● Work in a well\-equipped school makerspace, with room to shape programmes as they grow

● Exposure to national robotics competitions and school\-industry partnerships

● Mentorship, training, and growth within a young, mission\-driven education team

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI Engineer (Agents & Systems)
description:
**About The Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled and communicative AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications. This is a hybrid role that demands deep technical expertise in modern AI ecosystems alongside exceptional communication skills. You will not only build complex, production\-ready AI systems but also serve as a key technical liaison—translating complex AI concepts for clients, gathering requirements, and producing crystal\-clear technical documentation.

If you are just as comfortable writing complex orchestration logic for LLMs as you are leading a client presentation in flawless English, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Development \& Engineering:**

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent systems, and generative AI applications from scratch.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines tailored to specific business use cases.
* Optimize AI model performance, latency, and cost within production environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise software and workflows.

**Communication \& Client Facing:**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients, leading meetings to gather requirements, scope projects, and present technical solutions clearly and confidently.
* Translate business needs into actionable technical architectures and explain complex AI mechanics to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with internal product managers, developers, and leadership to ensure alignment on project goals.

**Documentation \& Process:**

* Create and maintain comprehensive, high\-quality technical documentation, including system architectures, API specifications, and user manuals.
* Draft clear client proposals, progress reports, and post\-deployment handover documents.
* Establish best practices for code quality, testing, and system documentation within the AI engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Skills:**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Software Engineering with at least 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on, proven experience building and deploying AI applications, LLM integrations, or AI agents in production.
* **Programming:** Advanced proficiency in Python and familiarity with Node.js or TypeScript.
* **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with modern AI orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
* **Models \& APIs:** Deep understanding of commercial and open\-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* **Cloud \& Deployment:** Experience deploying scalable applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, utilizing Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

**Communication \& Soft Skills:**

* **Language:** Exceptional proficiency in written and spoken English. Must be able to articulate complex ideas smoothly and professionally.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** Proven track record of interacting directly with clients, managing expectations, and delivering technical presentations.
* **Documentation:** Strong technical writing skills with a portfolio of past documentation (system designs, readmes, whitepapers, or client briefs).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing personal or open\-source contributions to AI agent frameworks.
* Experience with UI/UX prototyping tools (Streamlit, Gradio, or Next.js) to build quick proof\-of\-concepts for clients.
* Previous experience in a consulting, agency, or fast\-paced startup environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
